title: JsChatManageMent
description: ChatGuardX is an advanced Minecraft Paper 1.21+ plugin that provides complete chat moderation backup and security system for servers. It includes anti spam caps detection blacklist filters and link blocking to keep chat clean. The plugin supports mute unmu
body:
ChatGuardX is an advanced and lightweight Minecraft Paper 1.21+ plugin designed to provide complete control over server chat, moderation, and security systems. It is built for server owners who want a powerful yet simple solution to manage player communication, prevent spam, and maintain a clean and friendly community environment.

The plugin includes a fully customizable chat system with formatting support, emoji replacement, anti-spam protection, caps detection, blacklist word filtering, and link blocking. It also features a robust moderation system including mute, unmute, warning tracking, and automatic punishment options to ensure fair gameplay and safe communication.

ChatGuardX introduces a powerful backup system that automatically saves chat logs and allows administrators to create manual backups. These backups can be viewed through an interactive GUI, making it easy to review past chat activity anytime. Additionally, the plugin supports Discord integration through webhooks, allowing real-time chat, join, and leave messages to be sent directly to a Discord server.

For enhanced security, ChatGuardX also includes command blocking, preventing players from using sensitive server commands. A built-in ban system provides temporary bans, IP bans, and a customizable ban screen with Discord support links for appeals.

Overall, ChatGuardX is a complete all-in-one solution for chat moderation, server protection, and communication management in Minecraft servers.
